about: Krypton coins verified by the Genoryn project (docs/spec/assets.md). Signed with the release key under the context genoryn-krypton/verified-coins/v1. Verification is about identity only: it says who issues a coin, never that it is safe or worth anything.

coins.name: Dollar Krypton
coins.note: Issuer-backed by US dollar reserves held by the issuer: 1 USDK per US dollar; redeemed by burning. Never pausable.

coins.name: Euro Krypton
coins.note: Issuer-backed by euro reserves held by the issuer: 1 EURK per euro; redeemed by burning. Never pausable.

coins.name: Bitcoin Krypton
coins.note: Issuer-backed by bitcoin held by the issuer: 1 BTCK per BTC, so it follows the price of bitcoin; redeemed by burning. At most 21,000,000. Never pausable.

coins.name: Geno Krypton
coins.note: The project's test coin: exactly 10,000 GENOK, issued once, not backed by anything. Never pausable.
